name: Multiple Importance Sampling without Selection (mismvpt)
aliases: Multi-view Path Tracing with Classical MIS
definition: A multi-view rendering estimator using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) without prefix selection.
summary: Multiple Importance Sampling without Selection is an unbiased multi-view rendering estimator that combines base and shifted paths using standard MIS weights, avoiding prefix selection bias but suffering higher variance than self-normalized alternatives.
